display.purpose: Page titles — the one loud statement per screen.

title.purpose: Section and row titles: member names, invoice numbers.

body.purpose: Default text, 16px minimum, descriptions capped at max-w-3xl.

label.purpose: All-caps metadata: eyebrows, nav, status badges, button labels.

mono.purpose: Stats and technical detail — JetBrains Mono.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single action of each view: text-only vermillion with a breathing 2px underline.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 0; background: transparent; border: none; color: #FF3D00; font-family: 'Inter Tight', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: #FF3D00; transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF3D00; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary/link-like action: faded ink, 1px underline appears on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; background: transparent; border: none; color: #A3A3A3; font-family: 'Inter Tight', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-ghost::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 16px; right: 16px; bottom: 6px; height: 1px; background: #A3A3A3; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #FAFAFA; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF3D00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action that still feels like a button: 1px paper border, full inversion on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 16px 24px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #FAFAFA; border-radius: 0; color: #FAFAFA; font-family: 'Inter Tight', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #FAFAFA; color: #0A0A0A; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF3D00; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action (delete, void, cancel): ghost anatomy in vermillion.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; background: transparent; border: none; color: #FF3D00; font-family: 'Inter Tight', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-danger::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 16px; right: 16px; bottom: 6px; height: 1px; background: #FF3D00; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF3D00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Sharp, ash-filled field; border warms to vermillion on focus, no ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; background: #1A1A1A; border: 1px solid #262626; border-radius: 0; color: #FAFAFA; font-family: 'Inter Tight', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #A3A3A3; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #FF3D00; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Filter tab: hairline square, whispered caps; selected inverts to paper fill.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 16px; background: #0F0F0F; border: 1px solid #262626; border-radius: 0; color: #A3A3A3; font-family: 'Inter Tight', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11.2px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1); } .ds-chip:hover { color: #FAFAFA; border-color: #FAFAFA; } .ds-chip-selected, .ds-chip-selected:hover { background: #FAFAFA; color: #0A0A0A; border-color: #FAFAFA; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF3D00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Section Card
components.description: Sharp slate panel: hairline border, no shadow; accent variant swaps border to vermillion.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; background: #0F0F0F; border: 1px solid #262626; border-radius: 0; color: #FAFAFA; font-family: 'Inter Tight', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-card { padding: 32px; } } .ds-card-eyebrow { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 11.2px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #FF3D00; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.04em; } .ds-card-accent { border-color: #FF3D00; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: One meaning per color, carried by type: a word, not a dot.
components.css: .ds-status { font-family: 'Inter Tight', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11.2px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-good { color: #22C55E; } .ds-status-warning { color: #FFB300; } .ds-status-bad { color: #FF3D00; } .ds-status-neutral { color: #A3A3A3; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar item: whispered caps; active = vermillion text + 2px vermillion left rule.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: block; padding: 12px 16px; border: none; border-left: 2px solid transparent; color: #A3A3A3; font-family: 'Inter Tight', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1); } .ds-nav:hover { color: #FAFAFA; } .ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-active:hover { color: #FF3D00; border-left-color: #FF3D00; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF3D00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Row Menu
components.description: The 'More' overflow menu: hairline slate panel, whispered caps items, vermillion destructive.
components.css: .ds-menu { width: 224px; padding: 4px; background: #0F0F0F; border: 1px solid #262626; border-radius: 0; } .ds-menu-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; background: transparent; border: none; color: #A3A3A3; font-family: 'Inter Tight', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1), background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1); } .ds-menu-item:hover { color: #FAFAFA; background: #1A1A1A; } .ds-menu-danger, .ds-menu-danger:hover { color: #FF3D00; } .ds-menu-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF3D00; outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview: The system is poster design translated to web, put to work behind a gym's front desk. Typography is the entire visual language: headings are set like gallery wall text (Inter Tight, semibold, tight tracking -0.04em), labels whisper in wide-tracked all-caps (0.1em-0.2em), and the only color that ever raises its voice is vermillion #FF3D00. This is not friendly SaaS — it is a design manifesto that happens to run operations: check-ins, memberships, invoices, and class bookings rendered with the confidence of an exhibition catalog. Density is mid-weight editorial. Records are separated by full-width hairline rules (#262626, 1px) rather than cards-with-shadows; a panel exists only where a task needs a surface (#0F0F0F on #0A0A0A). Interaction is typographic first: the primary CTA is a text-only button whose accent underline breathes on hover (scale-x 1 → 1.1), and every press answers with a 1px translate-down. Nothing bounces, nothing glows — motion is fast and decisive (150–200ms, cubic-bezier(0.25, 0, 0, 1)). Because the audience is the desk staff in short bursts between members, hierarchy must be strict: headline → body → action, one action per view, and the vermillion voice reserved for what matters — check-in, payment, the active nav state, and errors.
keyCharacteristics: Type as hero: massive tight-tracked headlines, whispered wide-tracked labels
Restrained palette: carbon, warm paper, one vermillion accent + a semantic status quartet
Sharp edges everywhere (0px radius), hairlines as the only borders
Text-only CTAs with animated accent underlines — no button fills
Fast, decisive motion; press feedback via translate, never scale
Uppercase, wide-tracked labels as the recurring voice of navigation and metadata

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Vermillion appears on ≤5–10% of any given screen — key CTAs, active nav, statuses. If two loud things compete, one of them is wrong. Rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Poster Type Rule
rules.body: Type never shares the stage: one display statement per screen, and every label earns its caps. If a screen needs two competing headlines, the hierarchy is broken.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px #262626 lines, never shadows or fills. A screen without hairlines reads as unfinished; a screen that needs more than hairlines is trying to say two things at once.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, ever. Elevation is a color change or a line, not a lift. If a layer needs separation, give it a border and a lighter surface — not a shadow.

dos: Do set page titles text-3xl → sm:text-4xl → lg:text-5xl, semibold, -0.04em — the one display statement per screen.
Do whisper metadata: 0.7rem uppercase, 0.2em tracking, Faded Ink.
Do divide with 1px #262626 hairlines (border-b, py-5 rows) instead of card walls.
Do use the text-only primary CTA with its 2px vermillion underline for the single action of each view.
Do invert chips on selection (Warm Paper fill, carbon text).
Do use vermillion sparingly: active nav, key CTAs, eyebrows, destructive actions, focus outlines.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion — the app already collapses all transitions to ~0ms.
donts: Don't use box-shadows for elevation — tonal layering and hairlines only.
Don't add fills to primary buttons — text + underline is the primary affordance.
Don't let two vermillion elements compete on one screen.
Don't use filled icons or stroke widths above 1.5 — outline strokes only, currentColor.
Don't replace status words with colored dots — one meaning per color, type carries the message.
Don't bounce, glow, or spring motion — 150–200ms and cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1) only.
